name: QuietTraveler
concept: 차분한 남자 여행자: 청회색 머리, 짧은 청록색 망토, 크림색 튜닉, 가죽 가방과 갈색 부츠
packaging: Generated transparent sheets were sliced by grid cell, cropped to alpha > 32 bounds plus a two-pixel margin (alpha values preserved), resized proportionally to 122 pixels tall, and placed on transparent canvases. Idle bottom margin 3 px; walking bottom margin 25 px. Full source sheets preserved in Source/.
scope: Image assets and import metadata only; no CharacterSpriteSet, C# scripts, scenes, prefabs or character registration.
initial_design_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production character sprite turnaround sheet for a Korean-style 2.5D fantasy game, character named QuietTraveler.
Make exactly EIGHT full-body sprites of ONE identical young adult male traveler on a fully transparent canvas, in a precise 4-column by 2-row evenly spaced grid. No labels, no borders, no text, no ground, no shadow.
Character: calm kind reserved face, short tousled dark blue-gray hair with swept bangs, large muted gray-blue anime eyes, slender male build about 4.5 heads tall. An understated desaturated teal-blue short travel cape reaching just below his waist, simple silver clasp at collar, cream tunic, dark charcoal slim trousers, warm brown leather ankle boots. One small warm brown leather crossbody satchel at his anatomical left hip, strap from right shoulder to left hip. No weapons, no hats, no armor, no hood covering head. Hands relaxed by sides.
Style: polished fine-detailed 2000s Korean MMORPG hand-drawn anime game sprites, delicate selective dark outlines and soft cel shading, warm highlights, crisp readable small shapes. Not chunky low resolution pixel blocks, not 3D, not painterly.
Camera: fixed orthographic low top-down, see a little of the top of the head and shoulders, consistent camera and body proportions in every cell. Neutral standing pose in all eight cells.
Exact order, reading left to right:
ROW 1: SOUTH (front, looks toward viewer); SOUTH-EAST (front three-quarter, faces screen right); EAST (strict profile, faces screen right); NORTH-EAST (rear three-quarter, faces screen right, back of cape visible).
ROW 2: NORTH (full back, face entirely hidden); NORTH-WEST (rear three-quarter, faces screen left); WEST (strict profile, faces screen left); SOUTH-WEST (front three-quarter, faces screen left).
All eight depict SAME design rotated, satchel stays on anatomical left side. Full heads and boots with generous clear transparent margins, never clipped or touching neighbors. All feet on identical relative baseline, all bodies same height and width scale. Landscape 1536x1024 canvas, each cell 384x512; character height around 410 pixels, horizontally centered per cell. Production asset only, zero decorative layout.

generation_sheets.prompt:
EDIT image 1, the eight male traveler views. Image 2 (tiny lavender girl) is the EXACT GAME ART STYLE AND BODY PROPORTION reference.
Convert image 1 into compact actual MMORPG game SPRITES matching image 2. Critical: shorten bodies to 4.5 heads tall, enlarge heads and anime eyes, simplify details into crisp fine pixel/sprite clusters. Reference girl has large head, petite torso, slender short limbs. The male should match this scale and rendering as if created in the same game sprite pack. No realistic long legs or 7-head fashion-illustration proportions.
Preserve the male identity: tousled dark blue-gray hair, calm kind face, desaturated blue-teal waist-length cape with silver neck clasp, cream tunic, dark trousers, brown boots, brown crossbody satchel on anatomical left hip. No new props.
Remove EVERY background pixel: actual transparent alpha outside characters, ZERO dark gray backdrop, ZERO glows, ZERO vignettes, ZERO shadows, ZERO painted checkerboard. Empty space must be fully transparent.
Keep EXACTLY eight separate full-body neutral standing sprites, 4 columns by 2 rows. 1536x1024. Equal cells. Body height 350 pixels, large clear margins, same baseline per row and identical scale. Thin selective dark outline, crisp soft cel-shaded anime sprite shading, subtle warm highlights, exactly like lavender reference, not a painting.
Row1 left-to-right front; front-right three-quarter; strict right-facing profile; rear-right three-quarter.
Row2 left-to-right full back; rear-left three-quarter; strict left-facing profile; front-left three-quarter.
At rear views show back of hair and cape, do not turn head to viewer. No labels, text, guides, ground or border.
